name: preflight-processes
command: bash -lc set\ -e\;\ for\ spec\ in\ \'prefill-engine-deployment-7f4fc6ddc7-n884l\ prefill-engine\ prefill\'\ \'decode-engine-deployment-f6f4b9988-gxlwd\ decode-engine\ decode\'\;\ do\ set\ --\ \$spec\;\ kubectl\ exec\ -n\ liangjiahao\ \"\$1\"\ -c\ \"\$2\"\ --\ bash\ -lc\ \"test\ \!\ -e\ /tmp/vllm-\$3.pid\;\ \!\ pgrep\ -f\ \'\[v\]llm.entrypoints.openai.api_server\'\"\;\ done\;\ printf\ \'engines_stopped=true\\n\'

name: preflight-metrics
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao prefill-engine-deployment-7f4fc6ddc7-n884l -c prefill-engine -- env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c from\ urllib.request\ import\ urlopen\;\ print\(urlopen\(\"http://mooncake-master-service:9003/metrics\"\,timeout=10\).read\(\).decode\(\)\,end=\"\"\)

name: wait-prefill-http
command: bash -lc for\ _\ in\ \$\(seq\ 1\ 240\)\;\ do\ if\ kubectl\ exec\ -n\ liangjiahao\ prefill-engine-deployment-7f4fc6ddc7-n884l\ -c\ prefill-engine\ --\ python3\ -c\ \'import\ sys\,urllib.request\;\ response=urllib.request.urlopen\(sys.argv\[1\]\,timeout=5\)\;\ assert\ response.status==200\;\ sys.stdout.buffer.write\(response.read\(\)\)\'\ http://127.0.0.1:8100/v1/models\ 2\>/dev/null\;\ then\ exit\ 0\;\ fi\;\ sleep\ 5\;\ done\;\ exit\ 1

name: wait-decode-http
command: bash -lc for\ _\ in\ \$\(seq\ 1\ 240\)\;\ do\ if\ kubectl\ exec\ -n\ liangjiahao\ decode-engine-deployment-f6f4b9988-gxlwd\ -c\ decode-engine\ --\ python3\ -c\ \'import\ sys\,urllib.request\;\ response=urllib.request.urlopen\(sys.argv\[1\]\,timeout=5\)\;\ assert\ response.status==200\;\ sys.stdout.buffer.write\(response.read\(\)\)\'\ http://127.0.0.1:8200/v1/models\ 2\>/dev/null\;\ then\ exit\ 0\;\ fi\;\ sleep\ 5\;\ done\;\ exit\ 1
